blocks.title: Polymorphism
blocks.text: Polymorphism mukhtalif objects ki woh salahiyat hai ke ek hi method call ka apne tareeqe se jawab dein: ek interface, har object ka khaas rawayya.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
def animal_sound(animal):
....animal.make_sound()

animal_sound(Dog())    # Bark!
animal_sound(Cat())    # Meow!

blocks.prompt: animal_sound() polymorphism ki misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek hi call, animal.make_sound(), object ki class ke mutabiq mukhtalif nateeja deti hai, to function Dog aur Cat ko ek yaksan tareeqe se sambhalta hai.

items: Polymorphism: ek method ka naam, har class ka alag rawayya; animal_sound(Dog()) bhonkta, animal_sound(Cat()) meow.
